newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN DOWN THURSDAY IN PROFIT-TAKING.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN DOWN THURSDAY IN PROFIT-TAKING.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall in profit-taking on Thursday after having risen about 14 percent over the last eight sessions.
Analysts were divided on the depth and length of the expected downward correction after the recent rises fuelled by sudden foreign buying.
Brewer Brok starts trade on the bourse's third market on Thursday. On Friday the bourse closes for the Assumption Day holiday.
